candidate_workaround: Accumulate loop results in an explicit array and pipe the completed array to JSON serialization only after the loop closes.
failure_signature: PowerShell raised ParserError for an empty pipe element after a foreach statement block.
recurrence_guard: Do not pipe a statement-form foreach block directly in Windows PowerShell 5.1; collect its output first or use a pipeline-native ForEach-Object expression.
rollback: Give the parse-failed command zero word-count credit, preserve the error, and rerun with explicit array accumulation.
scope_boundary: Owner-local PowerShell syntax and document counting only; not content quality or independent reproduction.
title: Collect PowerShell statement-loop output before piping
